patch_description:
Crossover combining the current program's best-performing simulated annealing (SA) framework with the alternate programs' local-search neighborhoods. Key improvements:
1. Keep randomized greedy sampling for initial solutions (as in both parents).
2. Replace the pure-insertion SA move with a mixed neighborhood: random insertion (from the current best-scoring program) and adjacent/segment swaps (from the crossover program), since different move types escape different local optima.
3. Periodically restart SA from the best-so-far solution with reheating when the search stagnates, acting as iterated local search — this mixes the SA convergence of the current program with the multi-restart robustness of the greedy-restart parent.
4. Reheat/temperature schedule tuned relative to best_cost, accepting occasional uphill moves early and mostly downhill later, which reliably drove the current program to makespan 244.

This yields more thorough exploration of the schedule space within the time budget, leading to lower makespan.
